g.text: 整个基本算法只有两种 RPC
RequestVote 由候选人发起，AppendEntries 由领导者发起；第三种 InstallSnapshot 只用于传快照。
任期过期或日志不够新
任期过期或 prevLog 不符

1. Reply false if term < currentTerm2. Reply false if log doesn't contain an entry at prevLogIndex whose term matches prevLogTerm3. If an existing entry conflicts with a new one (same index but different terms), delete it and all that follow4. Append any new entries not in the log5. If leaderCommit > commitIndex, set commitIndex = min(leaderCommit, index of last new entry)
服务器并行发出 RPC，超时未收到响应就重试；Raft 的 RPC 是幂等的，重复收到不会造成损害。
